hints.title: Concatenate Formations
hints.text: Concatenate the text representations of n, 2 times n, and 3 times n.

hints.title: Digit Completeness
hints.text: Check whether the combined string has length 9 and contains no zero.

hints.title: Sorted Permutation Verification
hints.text: Verify that sorting the digits yields the sequence from 1 to 9.

hints.title: String Sort Comparison

complexity.notes: Concatenation and sort run on a fixed 9-character string.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual verification is error-prone; sorting the 9 digits provides instantaneous validation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Constructs the 9-digit string and checks 1-to-9 permutation concisely.
